questions.q: A restaurant chain keeps orders in a database, refunds in a spreadsheet and delivery sales in an app. What would an ETL pipeline do for them?
options: Replace the three systems with one new app
Collect, clean and combine the data into one place, without anyone doing it by hand
Email the sales numbers to the manager each morning
Back up each system separately in case of a crash
questions.explain: That's the whole idea. A pipeline extracts the data from each source, transforms it, and loads it into one destination, so nobody has to babysit it each day.

questions.q: What is the one real difference between ETL and ELT?
options: ETL is for small data and ELT is for big data
ETL needs a person to run it and ELT runs itself
ELT skips cleaning the data altogether
When the cleaning and reshaping happens: before loading in ETL, after loading in ELT
questions.explain: Microsoft puts it simply: the only difference is where the transformation happens. In ELT it runs inside the destination, using that system's own power.

questions.q: A pipeline copies only rows changed since its last run. Someone then deletes an order in the source. What happens?
options: The pipeline deletes it from the destination too
The pipeline stops and sends an alert
The pipeline never notices, because it only looks at rows that still exist
The pipeline copies the order again
questions.explain: A deleted row leaves nothing behind for the query to find. If deletes matter to you, the pipeline needs a different method for spotting changes.

questions.q: A run fails halfway and the scheduler retries it. What do you want the retry to do?
options: Add all the rows again, to be safe
Give the same result as one clean run, with no duplicate rows
Skip the retry and wait for the next day
Load whatever the latest data happens to be
questions.explain: A task that is safe to repeat leaves the same result however many times it runs. Airflow's advice is to use an upsert, not a plain insert, so a retry does not write the same rows twice.

questions.q: Which statement about ETL pipelines and data pipelines is true?
options: An ETL pipeline is one kind of data pipeline, the kind that transforms data before loading
They are two names for the same thing
A data pipeline is a type of ETL pipeline
ETL pipelines are always batch and data pipelines are always real time
questions.explain: A data pipeline is any automated movement of data. An ETL pipeline is one kind of it. Batch versus real time is a choice you make, not what separates them.
